verdict.rationale: Bugbot installs through the Cursor GitHub app, including GitHub Enterprise Server, and through the GitLab integration, including Self-Hosted. It runs automatically on every PR update and leaves inline comments with explanations and suggested fixes. Community users confirm it is live in their orgs and posting PR comments. missing for 10: any evidence of review turnaround time (the 'within minutes' part of the story), explicit confirmation that GitLab comments are native inline MR comments.
